name: Padmanabh Industries Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1994, Padmanabh Industries
Ltd is in the agri-trading business.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
PIL is engaged in trading agri goods, commodities, and agri materials. Its objectives include:
a) Oil & Petroleum: Import, export, refine, and trade oil products; set up extraction/refining plants; handle wholesale, retail, and cargo.
b) Real Estate & Construction: Build, renovate, and maintain residential, commercial, industrial, and institutional properties.
c) Land & Property Development: Acquire, lease, develop, and manage land; prepare sites, roads, parks, and real estate projects.
d) Infrastructure Projects: Develop and maintain roads, power, water supply, industrial zones, and related facilities.
e) Building Materials: Trade all types of building and infrastructure materials.

pros: Debtor days have improved from 384 to 74.0 days.
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 81.2 days to 28.6 days
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
